the interaction of small Fe clusters with graphene sheet having a vacancy defect.
the electronic and magnetic properties of Fe_n (n = 1, 2, 3, 4, 6) clusters in presence of a divacancy on graphene.
the chemical and magnetic properties of small iron clusters in presence of a graphene sheet.

the presence of the cluster in graphene sheet modifies the electronic structure of both cluster as well as graphene.

the presence of graphene modifies the chemical and magnetic properties of the clusters and the clusters modify the electronic properties of the graphene.

the presence of a divacancy can significantly alter the electronic and magnetic properties of a graphene sheet and that the chemical interaction of the divacancy with Fe clusters can further alter these properties.

the chemical interactions of the cluster with graphene is much stronger than the magnetic interactions.
